outline: 本課程藉由不同情境之英語錄影帶, 以及專題的語彙題目來提供一個英語談話的情境使學生能學習合宜的詞句。小組討論、角色演練、口頭報告皆為主要教學技巧，俾能增強學生之聽說能力。
schedule:
The Syllabus for 4E1 English Conversation, 2016(2)
Week	Topics	Extensive materials
1	Introduction
2	It should be banned.	Passive smoking
3	Marriage-for better or for worse	Church weddings for divorcees
4	Sexual harassment	Sexism behind motor shows
5	Torture	UK Prison Conditions
6	Designer babies	Fertility treatment
7	Nobody needs a gun	Gun crime in UK
8	The sale of human organs	UK Asian organ donation
9	Presentation
10	Are you happy with your body	Body piercing hygiene risks
11	Is this news	TV and family communication
12	The right to die	Assisted euthanasia
13	Anxiety and depression	Formula for happiness
14	Begging	Beggars in New Delhi
15	Legalizing drugs	Risks of Ecstasy use
16	Turning the other cheek	Teenage problems
17	Presentation
18	Final report
assessment:
1.	Weekly tests and Attendance. 80%
2.	Oral reports and presentations. 20%
